text:
anya: quick idea for next-week micro experiment: combine 20 starter credits + micro-webinar + a 3-prompt template pack for new signups (last 21 days).
cal: what primary metric are we optimizing?
anya: 7-day activation rate (first generation). target lift 6-10% vs holdout.
drew: can we gate webinar RSVP and only give credits on attendance? concern about credit abuse.
mira: yes attendance-only grant. also add hidden param route=microseed so we can trace banner vs email.
cal: segment = signup_date <=21d && total_generations=0 && not_on_trial. will export and drop CSV in drive.
badge-bot: reminder: workflow "credits_auto_grant" needs manager approval before write.
drew: RSVP page ready for A/B test copy variants. will A/B banner short vs narrative copy.
anya: email copy will be consistent; banner alone AB. cal please set split 60/40 exposed:control to increase power.
cal: noted. setting 60/40. dropping draft CTAs in drive: "Try Redwood — get 20 credits + 3 starter prompts" and "Join our 30m micro-webinar: credits + prompts"
mira: analytics: funnel keys = banner_clicks (route param) -> rsvps -> attendees -> first-gen events. set early alert if rsvps >> attends by 2x.
drew: i'll host the 30m session tues 10am. mira pls own prompt pack and credit approval.
anya: schedule quick sync mon 9am to confirm assets. thanks team :rocket:
